::: {.callout-problem title="Station card: Doppler Shift Spectrometer (6–8 minutes)"}
**Artifact:** a “radial velocity” card (line + shift + claim).

1) Pick a line (Hα or Na D).
2) Set a nonzero velocity with the slider.
3) Record:
   - $\lambda_0$ (nm),
   - $\lambda_{\text{obs}}$ (nm),
   - $\Delta\lambda = \lambda_{\text{obs}} - \lambda_0$ (nm),
   - the inferred direction (approaching or receding).
4) Compute $v = c\,\Delta\lambda/\lambda_0$ and compare to the slider readout.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Word bank + sanity checks"}
**Word bank:**
- **Radial velocity:** line-of-sight motion (toward/away).
- **Redshift:** $\Delta\lambda > 0$ (receding).
- **Blueshift:** $\Delta\lambda < 0$ (approaching).

**Sanity checks:**
- If $v_r = 0$, then $\lambda_{\text{obs}} = \lambda_0$ and $\Delta\lambda = 0$.
- In transverse mode, wavelengths do not change.
:::
